title: Dracula
author: Bram Stoker
premise: Young solicitor Jonathan Harker travels to Transylvania to help a reclusive count buy a house in England, and slowly realises he is a prisoner in the castle.

moments.title: A prisoner in the castle
moments.happened: Harker finds every door locked, then sees the Count crawl head-first down the castle wall.
alternatives: Jonathan escapes in the first week

moments.title: The ship at Whitby
moments.happened: A ship drifts into Whitby harbour with its crew gone, and a great dog leaps ashore.
alternatives: The dog is caught on the beach

moments.title: Lucy’s decline
moments.happened: Despite blood transfusions from four men, Lucy grows weaker night after night.
alternatives: Van Helsing arrives a week sooner
Lucy marries Arthur and leaves Whitby

moments.title: The tomb in Hampstead
moments.happened: Van Helsing leads the men to Lucy’s tomb to set her soul free.

moments.title: Mina is bitten
moments.happened: The Count visits Mina and binds her to him, linking her mind with his.
alternatives: The men keep Mina with them

moments.title: The boxes of earth
moments.happened: The hunters destroy the Count’s boxes of earth across London, leaving him one refuge.
alternatives: They miss the boxes in Piccadilly

moments.title: The race to the castle
moments.happened: The hunters chase the Count’s cart back to Transylvania, racing the setting sun.
alternatives: The sun sets before they reach him
